title: Cloud Security Engineer (m/f/d)
description: About the role: ​ As a Cloud Security Engineer, you will be a significant key function of our Global IT Team and design, implement and continuously improves security controls across our global cloud, identity and SaaS landscape. The role translates security architecture into practical, automated and secure-by-default controls, with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID. With our world-class team, you will play a pivotal role in pushing the boundaries of drone technology. ​ You will work closely with stakeholders from R&D, Global IT, Enterprise Risk and subsidiaries to ensures that security is built into technology decisions by design, while enabling teams to move quickly and securely. With risk-oriented judgment and hands-on mentality, you will support Quantum Systems in its mission to become the benchmark for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV).​ What is your Day to Day Mission: Design and implement security controls across Azure, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID.​ Engineer Zero Trust, Conditional Access, phishing-resistant MFA, PIM/PAM and workload identity controls.​ Build cloud security baselines using Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud and Infrastructure as Code.​ Secure cloud networking, Key Vault, certificates, secrets, encryption and privileged access.​ Identify and remediate cloud vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, excessive permissions and attack paths.​ Ensure relevant cloud, identity and M365 security telemetry is available to SIEM/XDR and SOC.​ Automate security controls and remediation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph, Terraform/Bicep and KQL.​ Support security incidents involving cloud services, identities and privileged access.​ Work closely with Security Architecture, Infrastructure, Engineering and SOC teams.​ What you bring to the team: You have a degree/ completed training in the field of Informatics, Cyber Security or comparable field experience​ You already have at least +5 years of professional experience in cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud or security engineering.​ Broad technical knowledge across Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Defender XDR, CrowdStrike Falcon, GitHub Enterprise, Terraform and Kubernetes.​ Strong understanding of IAM, Zero Trust, RBAC, PIM/PAM and Conditional Access..​ Practical knowledge of cloud networking, logging, vulnerability management and security automation.​ Experience with Infrastructure as Code and scripting/automation.​ Strong communication skills across engineering teams, technical leadership and management.​ Communication in English is a matter of course for you.​ Relevant certifications such as AZ-500, SC-100, CISSP or CCSP are beneficial but not mandatory.​ Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. At Quantum Systems, you’ll work alongside experts across disciplines, take ownership from day one and help turn ambitious ideas into technology with real-world impact. We move fast, think beyond boundaries and give our teams the space to shape what comes next. The Future is Unmanned - But the responsibility is not. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success. At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas.
